newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-HESP BECOMES BARCELONA'S FOURTH GOALKEEPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HESP BECOMES BARCELONA'S FOURTH GOALKEEPER.

text.p: Barcelona have signed Dutch goalkeeper Ruud Hesp, Spanish newspapers reported on Saturday.
Hesp, 31, was the Netherlands' third choice 'keeper at last year's European championship.
Barcelona are reported to have signed Hesp from Dutch Cup-winners Roda JC on a three-year contract but no details were given about the transfer fee.
He is the first signing directly initiated by new coach Louis Van Gaal and will become the Catalan club's fourth goalkeeper.
Hesp is looking to oust Portuguese international Vitor Baia as the first-choice man between the posts.

Barcelona also have former Spanish international Julen Lopetegi and Carlos Busquets in their senior squad but Lopetegi, 31, has already indicated that he wants to leave and a move to Celta Vigo has been rumoured.
